 At Jabalpur

sentences.text:
Shri J. A. Shah - Advocate for the appellant.
 Shri S. K. Rai - Govt. Advocate for respondent/State.
Appellant has filed I.A. No.24540/2023 an application under Section 389(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure for suspension of jail sentence.

2. Appellant has been convicted under Sections 366 and 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 5 with fine of Rs. 2000/- and R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs. 8000/-,
with default stipulations.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that prosecutrix was aged more than 16 years and appellant was also young boy at the time of incident.
It is submitted that prosecutrix in her deposition stated that earlier statement given to police was true.
It is submitted that in the said statement it was stated that she herself has gone to the house of appellant and proposed him.
It is submitted that no offence of rape has been committed by the appellant.
He draws attention of this Court towards deposition.
In these circumstances, appellant's sentence may be suspended and he may be released on bail.
4. Learned Government Advocate opposed the application for suspension of sentence and submitted that offence is serious in nature.
Imprisonment of 10 years is imposed upon the appellant.

5. Heard the counsel for the parties.
6.
Considering the age of appellant and prosecutrix and her deposition, I.A. No.24540/2023 for suspension of sentence is allowed.

7. It is hereby directed that the custodial sentence awarded to the appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this appeal and he shall be released on bail subject to depositing the fine amount if already not deposited and on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
(Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety bond of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Sohan @ Pucha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184838672/
1 trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 7.08.2024 and on other dates as may be fixed in this regard till final disposal of this appeal.
C.C.
